Hi Tara — welcome, and thanks for the clear questions. Short answers up front, then details and links below.

TL;DR: Portal preferred for onboarding (one canonical source + automatic PO matching). Fallback email: invoices@redwood.ai. Required fields: Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Redwood PO Number (mandatory), Vendor Name, Line Item rows (desc, qty, price), Invoice Total, Remit To. We also surface an acknowledgement header (X-Redwood-Invoice-ID) on success if you upload via the portal/API.

Details:
- Portal: https://portal.redwood.ai/invoice-upload — please use this for all production invoices. It supports manual upload and an API token for automated pushes.
- API/SFTP: API preferred; SFTP is available for high-volume partners. If you want API credentials I can kick off an onboarding ticket.
- Fallback email: invoices@redwood.ai (only for vendors who cannot use the portal). When sending by email include the PO number in the subject like: INV|PO12345|Starlite|INV-12345. That helps our ingest pipeline.
- Acknowledgement header: when the portal accepts an invoice we emit an X-Redwood-Invoice-ID in the HTTP response and also in the notification email. There is no mandatory custom SMTP header for email submissions, but we rely on subject parsing for emails.
- PO stamping: Not required. The PO number must be clearly visible on the invoice PDF or in the file name and/or the subject line so it can be auto-matched.
- Minimal CSV line example (for your billing system):
  InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate,PO,VendorName,LineDescription,Qty,UnitPrice,Tax,Total,RemitName,RemitAddress
  INV-12345,2027-05-28,PO-00987,Starlite Systems,Consulting retainer,1,12500.00,0.00,12500.00,Starlite Systems,1234 Oak St, San Francisco CA

Attachments we use for onboarding: vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (please complete), redwood-invoice-sample.csv (CSV sample). I've attached the two files to this thread for convenience.

Next steps I recommend:
- Fill and sign the onboarding form (link below / attached).
- Upload your first invoice via portal or provide an API point; we can test and confirm the X-Redwood-Invoice-ID acknowledgment.

If you'd like, Monica is our vendor integrations lead and can run the API credential request. Marissa will triage onboarding tickets on her side.
